IRS990.Desc: Affordable Housing: On January 31, 2024, the organization acquired a multifamily rental housing development located in San Jose, California. The 6-story property includes 168 residential units and 18,151 square feet of commercial space. Pursuant to a Regulatory Agreement, the organization is committing at least 20% of residential units for very low income tenants (at or below 50% of area median income) and at least 75% of units for low income tenants (at or below 80% of area median income). Rents for these units are set at affordable rates in compliance with federal and local housing standards. The property includes 4 commercial tenants that pre-date the organization's acquisition. While these commercial leases generate unrelated debt-financed income, these activities remain ancillary to the organization's primary affordable housing mission.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Fiscal Sponsorship: The Organization serves as fiscal sponsor to JDL Strategies, LLC, supporting its charitable project to assess land banking as a solution for community-centered affordable housing production and preservation in Marin County, California. As fiscal sponsor, the Organization receives and administers charitable contributions and grants for the project, ensuring proper oversight and disbursement of funds for project-related expenses.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: Grantmaking: Under its mission to serve essential workers and their families, the organization has made grants since its founding to subsidize rent costs for Marin County's public school teachers and other educators under its Rent Relief Grant Program. The program is currently carried out in collaboration with Serenity at Larkspur Apartments, and the grants are applied directly toward rent expenses.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Organization qualifies as a tax-exempt corporation under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code. The operations of the Subsidiary are included in the annual information return of the Organization and, therefore, are not subject to income tax, except on net income derived from unrelated business activities. During the year ended June 30, 2024, the Organization and Subsidiary had income derived from unrelated business activities which is solely attributable to the commercial lease that is debt financed and unrelated business expenses, related to interest, depreciation, and other related expenses, that offsets this income. No provision or liability for income taxes is reflected in the consolidated financial statements. The Organization believes that it has appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and as such, does not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the consolidated financial statements. The Organization is required to file and does file tax returns with the Internal Revenue Service and other taxing authorities. Generally, income tax returns filed by the Organization are subject to examination by the Internal Revenue Service for a period of three years. While no income tax returns are currently being examined by the Internal Revenue Service, tax years since 2021 remain open.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Grantmaker's Description of How Grants are Used
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The organization operates a Rent Relief Grant Program to support Marin County's public school teachers and educators with housing costs. Grants are awarded to qualified educators and applied directly toward their rent expenses at Serenity at Larkspur Apartments. The organization maintains oversight through direct application of grant funds to rent payments, eliminating the risk of funds being used for other purposes. The organization maintains documentation of grant amounts and their application to rent expenses, and conducts periodic reviews of the program's effectiveness in supporting educator housing needs.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule L, Part V Supplemental Information
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The organization has the following related party transactions: (1) On January 29, 2024, the organization entered into loan agreements with Linda M. Assante's Trust ($100,000) and Catalyst Housing Group LLC ("CHG") ($1,900,000) to provide supplemental financing to the 501(c)(3) bonds for acquiring the property, funding operating expenses, capitalized interest, costs of issuance, and certain reserves. Both loans are unsecured, bear 4% annual interest, with interest accruing annually and all payments due at maturity on January 29, 2034. Linda M. Assante is a current director and Secretary, while CHG is an entity in which Jordan Moss (former director and President) holds a 35% or greater beneficial ownership and Annie Koo (current director and President) serves as an executive employee. (2) The organization's ending liability balance reflects a reimbursement payable to CHG for professional fees, transaction costs related to the organization's acquisition of a 168-unit affordable housing complex in January of 2024, and other ongoing costs. Due to the organization's initial funding constraints, CHG advanced these costs to facilitate the acquisition closing and initial operations. The organization will reimburse CHG when funding is available, with no additional costs or interest charged. (3) On January 31, 2024, the organization entered into an Asset Management Agreement with CHG to oversee operations, maintenance, record-keeping, and reporting for the property. The agreement provides for reasonable compensation in accordance with IRS regulations, including Rev. Proc. 2017-13, for 501(c)(3) bond-financed properties. The compensation structure is not based on net profits and maintains the organization's ultimate control and oversight. Following procedures under IRC Section 4958, corresponding regulations, and the organization's Conflict of Interest Policy, all arrangements were approved by disinterested directors who determined them to be fair, reasonable, and in furtherance of the organization's exempt purposes of providing affordable housing.
